section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a one-item dietary restraint measure adapted from the EDE-Q Restraint subscale, rated on a 1-5 scale. The measure was validated by showing strong correlation (r = .67) with the full EDE-Q Restraint subscale administered 4-6 days prior, with average weekly dietary restraint scores of 2.15 (SD = 1.02) across participants.
